content.text:
Here are good places to get **free 3D game assets**:

| Site | Best for | License notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Kenney** | Low-poly game packs, props, characters, UI, audio | Usually **CC0**, very game-dev friendly |
| **Quaternius** | Low-poly characters, monsters, vehicles, environments | Often **CC0** |
| **Poly Haven** | High-quality models, HDRIs, PBR textures | **CC0**, safe for commercial use |
| **OpenGameArt** | Mixed 2D/3D game assets, sprites, models, sounds | Check each asset’s license |
| **Sketchfab** | Huge library of 3D models | Filter by **Downloadable** and check license |
| **Unity Asset Store** | Free Unity-ready 3D assets | Check asset-specific license |
| **Unreal Fab / Marketplace** | Unreal-ready free assets, including some Megascans-style content | Check license/engine restrictions |
| **ambientCG** | PBR materials/textures for 3D environments | **CC0** |
| **FreePixel** | Indie-game-ready GLB assets | Offers free GLB models for Unity, Godot, Blender, Three.js ([freepixel.art](https://freepixel.art/3d-assets?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Artaley3D** | Scanned/handmade 3D props and textures | Free **CC0** assets ([artaley3d.com](https://artaley3d.com/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Open Source 3D Assets** | GLB models for games/VR/3D projects | Curated **CC0/open-source** assets ([opensource3dassets.com](https://www.opensource3dassets.com/?utm_source=openai)) |

**Best picks if you want “no headache” licensing:**
1. **Kenney**
2. **Quaternius**
3. **Poly Haven**
4. **ambientCG**
5. **Artaley3D**

Look for **CC0** assets if you want to use them in commercial games without attribution. For **CC BY**, you can usually use them for free, but you must credit the creator. Avoid unclear “free” licenses unless you read the terms.
